theorem Roth.index_mul_left_weights.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {l : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ)
  (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ), (Roth.index P α fun j ↦ l * r j) = Roth.index P α r / ↑l :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {l} P α r ↦
  have himg :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (Roth.weight fun j ↦ l * r j) '' ↑((MvPolynomial.taylor α) P).support = _a)
          (Eq.symm Set.image_smul)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (Roth.weight fun j ↦ l * r j) '' ↑((MvPolynomial.taylor α) P).support = _a)
            (Set.image_image (fun x ↦ (↑l)⁻¹ • x) (Roth.weight r) ↑((MvPolynomial.taylor α) P).support)))
        (Set.image_congr fun d x ↦
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = (↑l)⁻¹ • Roth.weight r d) (Roth.weight_mul_left r d)))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ Roth.weight r d / ↑l = _a) (smul_eq_mul (↑l)⁻¹ (Roth.weight r d))))

                (Eq.refl ((↑l)⁻¹ * Roth.weight r d))))));
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = Roth.index P α r / ↑l) (Roth.index.eq_1 P α fun j ↦ l * r j)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ sInf ((Roth.weight fun j ↦ l * r j) '' ↑((MvPolynomial.taylor α) P).support) = _a / ↑l)
          (Roth.index.eq_1 P α r)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ sInf _a = sInf (Roth.weight r '' ↑((MvPolynomial.taylor α) P).support) / ↑l) himg))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = sInf (Roth.weight r '' ↑((MvPolynomial.taylor α) P).support) / ↑l)
              (Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg' l))

              (Eq.refl ((↑l)⁻¹ * sInf (Roth.weight r '' ↑((MvPolynomial.taylor α) P).support))))))))

  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = Roth.index P (α ∘ f) (r ∘ f)) (Roth.index.eq_1 ((MvPolynomial.rename f) P) α r)))

          (Roth.index.eq_1 P (α ∘ f) (r ∘ f))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a ↦
              sInf (Roth.weight r '' ↑_a.support) =
                sInf (Roth.weight (r ∘ f) '' ↑((MvPolynomial.taylor (α ∘ f)) P).support))
            (MvPolynomial.taylor_rename f α P)))

          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a ↦
                sInf (Roth.weight r '' ↑_a) = sInf (Roth.weight (r ∘ f) '' ↑((MvPolynomial.taylor (α ∘ f)) P).support))
              (MvPolynomial.support_rename_of_injective hf)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg

            (Eq.mpr

              (congrArg sInf (Set.image_congr fun d x ↦ Roth.weight_mapDomain hf r d)))))))
